description: The last 7 days versus the previous 7 days in a single read: totals (clicks, impressions, CTR, position) with deltas, top-5 winning and losing pages, top-5 new and lost queries, top-3 quick wins and the top-3 pages with the largest position swing. Every list is bounded and server-ranked; numbers are co-occurrence observations and never name a cause — pair a drop with get_radar_updates before explaining it. Live GSC read on paid plans, daily-capped. Requires the audit:read scope.
name: get_gsc_weekly_report
title: One-call weekly GSC report
